objective: Best-known unconditional GAN and flow recipes under a 20 A10 training-minute budget per fresh model

budget.excludes: evaluation, setup, checkpoint/volume I/O; record worker wall time separately
budget.stopping: synchronize/check every10updates; overshoot at most one10-update block, must be <=5 seconds

selection.gan: Original paired CNN + EMA(.999), Adam2e-4 beta(.5,.999), reset Adam/sampling RNG/EMA at50k as experiment37
selection.gan_rationale: Paired EMA train FID49.28 vs independent-score49.25 on seeds1,2 is negligible; paired has better class TV. Cross-attention is slower, with no clear overall gain. No larger-network trial at this budget.
selection.flow_rationale: EMA was strongest repeatable intervention; lower LR had no convincing independent benefit. Fresh20min endpoint is new, not a110k warm start.
selection.caveat: Best-known choices from prior exploratory results, not established global optima or a new budget-specific tuning sweep.

sampling: uniform unconditional; no class labels, deficit or augmentation

evaluation.endpoint: final time-cap checkpoint only; no retrospective endpoint/weights selection
evaluation.references: same frozen references/classifiers as experiments36-38; exploratory, not untouched validation
